messages.author: 3c04c342136fe2e7
messages.subject: Welcome to the GSoC / R discussion list
parts:
Just a quick 'Hi and Thanks for coming' to everybody on the list. I
should mention that I will be the admin this year (having mentored
three students with R-related topics during GSoCs 2008 and 2009).
Manuel, who was admin last year, kindly agreed to look over my
shoulder and provide backup.

At this point I believe all-but-one mentors are on the list as well as
a few early-bird students. So if there are questions, please feel
free to fire them off to the list. And if the questions are more
narrow and concern just one topic and its details you can also send
them to only the corresponding mentor.

Regards, Dirk

messages.author: c4aedad45bfac602
messages.subject: Re: Welcome to the GSoC / R discussion list
parts:
General question: Is there a wiki or other site about becoming a
mentor in GSoC/R? Or is it not possible? (the deadlines on the GSoC
page look to have passed for some things) Is it as simple as creating
a wiki page?

I started a library for S4 classes/methods for spatiotemporal data a
while ago, and think it would be a good candidate. I also know some
people here who are interested in varying degrees. There are several
discrete stopping points that make it good candidate for people of
different skills.

Thanks,
Blair

proposal to the wiki, and register yourself as a mentor at the Google site
selecting 'R Project' as the org.
